message.reasoning_content:
I need to determine the additional clockwise rotation in degrees, within the range [0, 360), required to align the current object's facing direction with the reference direction.

The reference direction is indicated by the finger in image 1, which is pointing lower-right. Looking at the current object in image 2, its facing direction is downward.

The reference direction (lower-right) can be represented as a clockwise angle of 135 degrees. The current object's facing direction (downward) can be represented as a clockwise angle of 180 degrees.

The difference between the current angle and the reference angle is 180 - 135 = 45 degrees. Since this value is less than 360 degrees, it is the additional clockwise rotation needed.
